title: WordPress shared contact form: a message is mailed only to a configured recipient, never to the site's admin address
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/cms/tracy-wordpress-theme/test/tracy-contact.test.mjs (needs a local php, or a docker daemon for the php container).
S2: Record the exit code and the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail', '# skipped' lines.
S3: Run: grep -c "get_option( 'admin_email' )" packages/cms/tracy-wordpress-theme/src/tracy/functions.php and record the number.
expect: '# fail 0' and '# skipped 0'; '# pass' equals '# tests' and is at least 73 (one discovery case plus eight cases for each of the nine themes under src/).
S3 prints 0: the shared handler no longer reads admin_email.
evidence: TCH #811 F-S6-010: with tracy_contact_to unset a valid submit called wp_mail to admin_email (tracy-agent@tracy.ai on a site Tracy built) and answered contact=sent; on base 81e0a5473 the test file fails 45 of 73 cases.
fence: tracy_contact_submit refuses with contact=failed and sends nothing unless the stored or filtered recipient is a string that is_email() accepts; wp_mail returning false or throwing is failed too. Run in real PHP against a stub of WordPress: no SMTP, database or browser.
